methods.name: Sample quantiles (Hyndman-Fan types 1-9), IQR(type), bootstrap percentile interval
methods.reference: stats::quantile(type = 1..9); stats::IQR(type); quantile(x, c((1 - level)/2, (1 + level)/2), type = 7)
quantities: quantiles at 10 probabilities, types 1-9, n = 28 (ties) and n = 7
types 4-9 at p = (k - a)/(n + 1 - a - b) and the 4*eps fuzz gap case
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md closed-form tolerance (Tol::coef(n): n = 28, 7, 10); the fuzz and gap cases exact (they test which order statistic is chosen)

methods.name: Tukey five-number summary and box-plot statistics
methods.tolerance: Tol::coef(n) for stats; n, n_out and out exact

methods.name: Shared p-value and quantile helpers (t, chi-square, F, normal)
methods.reference: stats::pt, pchisq, pf, pnorm (lower.tail = FALSE); stats::qnorm, qt, qchisq
quantities: 2*pt(-|t|, df) for 15 (t, df) incl. p ~ 1e-40 and df up to 1e9
pchisq upper for 8 (x, df) incl. df = 0.01
pf upper for 7 (F, df1, df2) incl. F = 1e8 and df2 = 1e6
qt for 17 (p, df) incl. df = 2e7, 1e9 and p = 1e-12
qchisq for 12 (p, df) incl. the STAT-60 band (318, 320) and df = 0.01, 1e6
methods.tolerance: relative 1e-11 with no absolute floor (Tol::new(1e-11, 0.0)); measured maxima 1.5e-13 (pt), 1.2e-13 (pchisq), 6.1e-13 (pf), 3.6e-13 (qt), 8.0e-13 (qchisq)
